name: Hypercube Characterization Equivalence
hypotheses: Finite nonempty connected graph; the obstruction and invariant criteria assume the graph is a partial cube.
statement: The cube-graph, full-Boolean-family, one-obstruction, and equality-of-dimensions criteria define the same class.
proof: The graph and full-family forms are the same standard model. The one-obstruction equivalence is the cited pc-minor theorem. In an irredundant representation $C\subseteq2^X$, the isometric dimension is $|X|$ and the VC dimension is at most $|X|$; equality means that $X$ itself is shattered, hence $C=2^X$.
